name: What permits are required for installing a walk-in tub in Bay Area cities like San Mateo or Redwood City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for installing a walk-in tub in Bay Area cities like San Mateo or Redwood City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a walk-in tub often requires permits from your local city or county building department to ensure the work meets safety and structural codes. Typically, plumbing permits are needed for new water lines or drain modifications, and electrical permits if new circuits or outlets are installed. Structural permits may also be necessary if the tub's weight necessitates floor reinforcement. As your general contractor, we identify all required permits based on your specific location within the Bay Area, such as San Mateo or Redwood City, and manage the entire application and inspection process on your behalf.
